crossRefs.note: Behold, you are nothing, and your work is nothing. He who chooses you is an abomination.
Everyone who makes a carved image is vain. The things that they delight in will not profit. Their own witnesses don’t…
Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
Yahweh says, “Don’t learn the way of the nations, and don’t be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are…
“What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies…
The prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus it will be done to them.”

translations.web: Behold, all of their deeds are vanity and nothing. Their molten images are wind and confusion.
translations.bsb: See, they are all a delusion; their works amount to nothing; their images are as empty as the wind.
translations.kjv: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.
translations.asv: Behold, all of them, their works are vanity and nought; their molten images are wind and confusion.
